notes: Full regression preceded the final awaited-disposal result-gate correction; final-teardown and final-api-boundary are follow-up tests of that correction.
Browser journey uses a loopback HTTPS protocol harness, not the production React application.

final-api-isolated follows the full run and checks awaited disposal, true corrupt-history injection and browser collection isolation; previous browser failures were traced to ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED caused by concurrent Docker network changes.
Legacy positive teacher HTTP expectations are preserved as visible failures, not skipped or reclassified PASS.
Storage-only synthetic context fixtures test persistence mechanics, not JWT admission, durable reservation or replay authorization.
